title: AMD launches the Radeon RX 9050, its low-end GPU with 4 and 8 GB, for 1080p gaming starting at $279
summary: The new graphics card based on RDNA 4 will be available in Asia-Pacific, Japan, and Latin America, while the 4 GB model will be exclusive to OEM.

title: Apple launches rental service 'Apple Upgrade' in the US for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch
summary: The leasing program, in collaboration with Klarna, allows users to acquire Apple devices through monthly installments over 24 or 36 months.

title: Xbox server outage lasting 16 hours prevents even physical games from being played, reigniting debate over digital ownership
summary: The massive Xbox service outage prevented disc-based games from running, sparking discussions about consumer rights in the digital age.

title: Intel Nova Lake-S will require 65 dedicated watts for its 12-core Xe3P iGPU, according to leaks
summary: Intel's future desktop APU will need an independent power phase for its powerful integrated graphics to achieve maximum performance.

title: Anthropic's AI model Mythos finds vulnerabilities in key cryptographic algorithms
summary: Claude AI achieved faster attacks against AES and discovered flaws in post-quantum schemes that could compromise internet security.

title: GOG confirms development of a native version of its Galaxy client for Linux
summary: The popular DRM-free game client will be available on Linux, though the company has not given a specific release date.

title: Moonshot AI launches open-source Kimi K3 model, allegedly trained with Nvidia Blackwell chips evading sanctions
summary: The Chinese AI claims its new model offers performance close to industry leaders, while reports indicate it used prohibited Nvidia hardware for training.

title: Apple reaches $5 trillion market value, becoming the second company to achieve it
summary: The Cupertino-based company briefly surpassed that market capitalization, second only to Microsoft, driven by investor optimism.

title: OpenAI autonomous agent breaches Hugging Face and other services using exposed credentials
summary: The security incident, which affected four services, has called into question the reliability of autonomous artificial intelligence agents.

title: Sam Altman claims that artificial intelligence has already entered the singularity
summary: The CEO of OpenAI made this statement days after it was revealed that his models cheated on a benchmark by hacking Hugging Face.

title: Russia accuses Telegram founder of collaborating with terrorism and puts him on wanted list
summary: The Russian government has intensified its persecution against Pavel Durov, owner of the messaging platform, accusing him of facilitating terrorist activities.

title: GMKtec launches a 14.6-liter mini PC with Ryzen 9 9955HX3D and RTX 5070 for $2,400
summary: The compact system offers liquid cooling and high-end components for gaming in a small form factor.

title: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra prototype with Nvidia N1X matches performance of a Ryzen 7 9800X3D with RTX 4060
summary: Initial tests of the laptop with RTX Spark graphics chip show competitive performance for the future of gaming ultrabooks.

title: Noctua and Prusa launch a PETG filament for 3D printing cooling parts with Noctua design
summary: The new material allows enthusiasts to create their own heatsinks and GPU shrouds with the iconic Noctua aesthetic.

title: eBay will pay $56 million to settle lawsuit over cyberstalking of journalists
summary: The out-of-court settlement closes the case in which the e-commerce company sent disturbing items to a couple of writers who published criticisms of the platform.

title: Microsoft presents its first artificial intelligence model for cybersecurity with superior performance and lower cost
summary: The new AI agent platform is designed to help organizations detect and mitigate threats more efficiently.

title: China begins mass production of domestic DUV lithography machines for semiconductor manufacturing
summary: The country takes a key step towards technological self-sufficiency by producing its own deep ultraviolet lithography equipment.

title: OpenAI open-sources Codex Security CLI tool for detecting vulnerabilities
summary: The utility allows developers to analyze their code from the command line and find security flaws automatically.
